4. **Cost-Saving Initiatives (Marcus Li):** A proposal suggests implementing cost-saving measures (renegotiating contracts, reducing energy consumption, streamlining logistics) to save up to $200,000 in Q2.

5. **Capital Expenditure Overages (Oliver Grant):** Two major projects (new office building and IT infrastructure upgrade) came in 10% over budget, requiring financial projection adjustments and fund reallocation.
